$description: Antz Design System rule registry. Every rule has an id, an owner, a severity and how it is enforced. tools/check.mjs reads this file; a rule marked enforcedBy 'check' is checked automatically. Change a rule only through an RFC (governance/rfc/).

rules.statement: No raw colours (hex, rgb, hsl) outside tokens. Use a semantic --color-* or --hue-* token.
The brand green #37BD69 is a fill on light surfaces, never text, a thin line or a small icon. Use --color-accent-text for brand text and --color-accent-indicator for thin indicators.
Retired brand values are not used: lime #52F990, #38BD69, #36BC69.
Brand green never means a status. Success uses the success tokens.
One main (filled brand) action per header, drawer or dialog.
Primitive tokens (--green-40, --ink-700, ...) are never used outside tokens.css. Use the semantic token for the purpose.
No invented tokens: every var(--*) must exist in tokens.css or be a local custom property defined in the same file.
Semantic colour tokens reference primitives; they never hold raw values. Generated files are never edited by hand.
Font sizes come from --text-* tokens. No px, rem or em font sizes.
Only approved fonts: font-family must use --font-body, --font-heading or --font-mono.
Font weights come from --weight-* tokens.
Margin, padding and gap use --space-* tokens. Off-scale pixel values are not allowed (1px hairlines excepted).
Border radius uses --radius-* tokens (or 50% for circles).
Box shadows use --shadow-* tokens.
No arbitrary animation timings: durations use --duration-*, easing uses --ease-*.
Every animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion (the duration tokens do this automatically). Interface motion never exceeds 500ms.
No ad hoc gradients. Use --gradient-* tokens (washes, module, feature, scrim).

Washes are for large soft backgrounds and stat panels only. Pick the wash by meaning and keep it per topic; at most two different washes on one screen; never on buttons, data marks, status, or behind small text without the secondary text colour. Mortality, alerts and overdue figures never sit on the celebrate wash.
Focus outlines are never removed (outline: none / 0) unless the same rule supplies a visible replacement.
Icon-only buttons have an aria-label (or aria-labelledby).
Images have alt text (alt="" for decoration).
Every approved colour pair passes WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI) in light, dark and both high-contrast modes.
Use an existing component before building one. Duplicates (a second confirm dialog, toast or filter drawer) are not allowed.
Add and edit happen in the right work drawer (562px).
Published versions (releases/vX.Y.Z) are immutable. Changes reach them only through tools/release.mjs after the gate passes.
Products link a pinned release (releases/vX.Y.Z/), never the working copy at the repository root.
Deprecated class or token names (governance/deprecations.json) are not used in new work; use the replacement it names. Deprecated names keep working until a major release.
